verdicts.reason: In both, the white card covers almost the whole canvas, so the pop-art shapes that define the brand shrink to slivers at the edges. Both also break the headline badly, leaving 'can' alone on its own line, and the FIZZBANG logo pill is oversized and competes with the headline. B is slightly worse because its CTA sits right against the bottom edge of the card and canvas, while A keeps a little room below the button.
